up: Retrieve all molecules that are reported in the document with ChEMBL ID CHEMBL1135903. For each distinct molecule, provide the following fields: the molecule's ChEMBL ID, its preferred name (if available), its maximum development phase, its molecule type, and its canonical SMILES (if available). Include molecules even if the SMILES structure is missing. Use the compound_records table to link documents to molecules.
sql: SELECT DISTINCT md.chembl_id AS molecule_chembl_id, md.pref_name, md.max_phase, md.molecule_type, cs.canonical_smiles FROM docs d JOIN compound_records cr ON d.doc_id = cr.doc_id JOIN molecule_dictionary md ON cr.molregno = md.molregno LEFT JOIN compound_structures cs ON md.molregno = cs.molregno WHERE d.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL1135903';
